description: Appliances bought when you moved in fail within a few years of each other. The clustering is arithmetic, not bad luck.

aspect: Emergency pricing is the only pricing available
description: A failure that cannot wait is bought at the rate of whoever will come today and whatever part is in stock.

description: Boiler on the 6th, exhaust on the 14th, laptop on the 22nd. None is a catastrophe. Together they are the whole month.
Products are increasingly built so that the economic choice is replacement, which is a decision made by a manufacturer and paid for by you.
